newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian bonds end weaker, pulled lower by U.S..
newsitem.headline: Canadian bonds end weaker, pulled lower by U.S..

text.p: Canadian bonds closed softer on Wednesday, pulled lower by weakness in U.S. treasuries, with modest gains in the Canadian dollar helping to support the market, analysts said.

"The focus was really on the bond auctions," said Harvinder Kalirai, Canadian analyst with financial analysis firm I.D.E.A. "The U.S. market saw a lot of profit taking after the results came out, so that sort of weighed on Canada as well."
Canada's 30-year benchmark fell C$0.45 to C$108.25 to yield 7.288 percent.
